intro: This step in the long-running Ashenvale investigation sees Dartol's Rod of Transformation fully restored. Entrusted with the completed artifact by the dryad Shael'dryn, you return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar to report success and honor the memory of the fallen scout Teronis.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I suggest you find Raene and let her know the rod is finished. I'm sure she'll know what your next course should be.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've recreated the rod Teronis had set out to find? That's wonderful to hear.
Teronis would be proud to see his quest is continuing even after his tragic passing.
